description: This Swift source file defines a SwiftUI View called CalculatorView and a corresponding ViewModel CalculatorCardViewModel for a calculator feature within an iOS app. It provides UI components for user input, operation buttons, and displays calculation results, encapsulating calculator logic and UI rendering.

classes.name: CalculatorCardViewModel
classes.description: A view model managing calculator input and results, providing methods for arithmetic operations and input parsing, and formatting the displayed result.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the parsed input value to the current result.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts the parsed input value from the current result.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the current result by the parsed input value.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Divides the current result by the parsed input value, handling division by zero.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the input and result to their initial states.

methods.name: parseInput
methods.description: Parses the input string into a Double, accepting both comma and dot as decimal separators.
